mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for UNRATE trend is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL threshold is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200 thousand units signals weakening residential construction, a key component of consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST falls below 1200, or the Rank IC for HOUST threshold is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and fall in unemployment rate signals a monetary tightening cycle amid strong labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to heightened recession risk.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales (RSAFS) coupled with a falling industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong consumer demand but weak supply chain capacity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to inflationary pressures and profit margin compression.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.5% and INDPRO falls > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rising federal funds rate compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a rising employment level (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal robust economic momentum that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions with rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE, or the Rank IC for the interaction in late-cycle expansions is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
